get.description: API to get director master data using DIN (Director Identification Number)

parameters.name: din
parameters.description: 8-digit unique identification number, which is allotted by the central government to each individual who is a director of any company

parameters.name: consent
parameters.description: Consent of the end-user to get their information for verification purposes. Possible values: Y and y

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Purpose for which the user has given their consent. Min length: 20 characters

message.example: DIN Entered does not match our Records, Please enter a Valid DIN.
